notes: Entropy source for the original_radio concept pass. Atoms are timeless,
SFW, weapon-free, and modern-tech-free by authoring rule;
the loader also runs the shared forbidden-term scan at load (fail loud).
Axis count and atom counts are schema-validated (min 6 per axis); the
deck grows freely after first production (kibitz r4 P7).

place: a canal lock keeper's stone cottage
the back room of a shuttered auction house
a tidal causeway that drowns twice a day
a rooming house above a printing shop
a branch-line railway halt in fog
an observatory dome with a cracked shutter
a lighthouse supply boat at anchor
a market square the morning after a fair
a telephone exchange on the night shift
object: a ledger with one page razored out
a wedding ring found inside a fish
a wax cylinder recording of a stranger's voice
a pawn ticket for an item never named
a lifeboat oar carved with two sets of initials
a jar of honey from hives nobody keeps
a theatre costume with real bloodstains of beet dye
a map fold-worn along one impossible road
a clock that keeps somebody else's time
a bundle of letters tied with surveyor's twine
a christening gown posted with no note
occupation: a piano tuner who works by ear alone
a milliner with a single wealthy client
a rural postman on a bicycle
an insurance assessor of small disasters
a lamplighter behind on his round
a ferrywoman who never learned to swim
an understudy who has never gone on
texture: cut hay through an open shutter
ink, blotting sand, and sealing wax
radio_device: a repeated sound the audience learns to dread
one voice heard only through a wall
a countdown the characters keep mishearing
a message repeated until its meaning changes
a silence where a reply should be
two conversations interleaved on one line
a confession rehearsed to the wrong listener
an echo that answers a beat too late
a list read aloud that shortens each time
a knock whose pattern is a name
a song resumed exactly where it broke off
a stranger who knows the room by sound alone
